gaps.gap: No brand owns 'charcoal-free + toxin-free + luxury' together
gaps.strategy: Category-defining brand. When people think 'clean luxury incense', they should think SEWA. No competitor combines all 5 USPs in one product.
tactics: Launch 'What's NOT in your incense?' awareness campaign — educate consumers about charcoal, phthalates, and toxins in regular incense
Create comparison content: SEWA vs regular incense — visual smoke test, fragrance test
Publish 'The Clean Incense Guide' — a definitive buyer's guide positioning SEWA as the authority
Partner with health/wellness influencers who can authentically talk about indoor air quality
Get certified: organic certification, toxin-free certification for third-party credibility

📊 CAROUSEL: '5 things hiding in your incense' — educational swipe series
🎬 REEL: 'The Smoke Test' — light regular incense vs SEWA side by side, time-lapse the difference
📝 BLOG: 'Why Charcoal-Free Is the Future of Incense'

gaps.gap: Quick-commerce (Blinkit/Zepto) incense is under-branded — no premium player dominates
gaps.strategy: Own the 10-minute incense category. When someone searches 'incense' on Blinkit at 9 PM, SEWA should be the first result.
tactics: List ALL SKUs on Blinkit and Zepto with optimised titles including 'charcoal-free' and 'toxin-free'
Create impulse-buy packaging: small packs (₹99-₹199) perfect for quick-commerce baskets
Run platform-specific promotions: 'Late night calm' discount after 9 PM
Bundle with complementary products: incense + holder combo, candle + matches pack
Dominate search results with keyword-optimised listings and high review velocity
Offer exclusive quick-commerce only variants to create FOMO

gaps.gap: Corporate gifting — Diwali hampers with toxin-free luxury products = untapped
gaps.strategy: Every corporate Diwali hamper includes generic sweets and dry fruits. SEWA offers something different: a luxury wellness gift that aligns with CSR values.
tactics: Create corporate gifting brochure with tiered options: Silver (₹499), Gold (₹999), Platinum (₹1,999)
Offer corporate branding: company logo on packaging, customised thank-you cards
Target HR and admin heads on LinkedIn with direct outreach
Partner with corporate gifting aggregators (BigSmall, Brown Living, Sublime House of Tea as cross-sell)
Run 'Gift Wellness This Diwali' B2B campaign 6 weeks before Diwali
Offer GST invoices and bulk discount slabs: 10-50 units (10%), 50-200 (15%), 200+ (20%)
